company.shortDescription: BloomTech provides online technical coding courses including data science, full-stack web and backend development, and free coding courses.
company.description: BloomTech helps learners of all backgrounds launch tech careers. The company aims to provide a direct, low-risk path to higher income by teaching the skills employers want plus supporting applicants in their job search. The simplified training provided by BloomTech equips applicants for careers in data science, software engineering, and other fields.
